 Print AIBE 22 admit card 2026 released The Bar Council of India (BCI) has released the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) 22 admit card 2026. Candidates who have registered for the examination can download their hall tickets from the official website, allindiabarexamination.com. Candidates will need their login credentials, including their application number and password, to access the admit card. The AIBE 22 examination will be conducted on November 29, 2026, in offline mode. Candidates must download their admit cards and take a printout to the examination centre. How to download AIBE 22 admit card 2026 ?
 Candidates can follow the steps given below to download their AIBE 22 hall tickets: Visit the official website, allindiabarexamination.com.
 On the homepage, click on the AIBE 22 admit card 2026 download link.
 Enter your login details, including your application number and password.
 Submit the details to access your admit card.
 The AIBE 22 hall ticket will appear on the screen.
 Check all the details mentioned on the admit card.
 Download the hall ticket and take a printout for the examination.
 Direct link here. Details mentioned on AIBE 22 admit card
 The AIBE 22 admit card will contain important details related to the candidate and the examination. Candidates should check the following information carefully: Candidate's name
 Roll number
 Examination name
 Examination centre name and address
 Examination date and time
 Reporting time
 Candidate's photograph and signature
 Important examination-day instructions
 Candidates should verify all the details mentioned on their hall tickets. In case of any errors, they must contact the examination authorities for clarification.
